title: The conductor's answers to readers (board/talk/replies.json)
description: Written by conductor@PrompTugal.dinis. Each answer is sealed to one person's encryption key from board/person-keys.json with ws-ecies-1 (as data/sealed/), so only a browser holding that key opens it on /talk/ (assets/talk/talk.js, PTKeyring.open). Only to, about and at are readable by anyone. Served as api/v1/talk/replies.json.

about.description: the page the comment was on, relative to the site root, e.g. algarve/loule/

in_reply_to.description: the comment's at, from its body

envelope.description: ws-ecies-1: ECDH P-256 with an ephemeral key, HKDF-SHA256 (empty salt, info ws-ecies-1), AES-256-GCM; the plaintext is JSON { text }
